name: Hanging baskets
desc:
These space savers are ideal for the small garden. They can be hung up anywhere! Small flowering and plants normally grown as ground covers are suitable for growing in these.
Couple of points to be considered while getting your baskets are:
A. What size? Get one suitable for the plant you require. Very small baskets dry out quickly and cause plant stress.
B. Where are you going to put your baskets. All balconies and terraces aobe the 2nd floor tend to be very windy. Baskets dry out quickly.
C. Strong hooks should be used for securing the baskets.
D. Use good quality media. Baskets particularly tend to dry out faster. The plants live longer. The potting mix in these should be of excellent quality.

name: Weed mats
desc:
Weed mats as the name suggests are mats for control of weeds. These are agricultural fabrics made from the same materials as shade nets.
These are used for control of weeds on ground beds and in large pots. They block light reaching the soil and also present a physical barrier for weed growth.
These fabrics let air and water pass through them. This makes them root friendly. Weed mats can be secured on the ground by digging a small trench at the edges and tucking the weed mats in. Holes or crosses can be cut in the weed mat where plants are to be planted. Weedmats are particularly useful for long term plants like fruit plants.
Weed mats help conserve soil moisture. They help keep the soil temperature low.
Weeds compete with plants for water and nutrients. By controlling weeds weedmats help plants grow better. Weeds also harbor many insect pests and diseases. Controlling weeds helps keep plants clean.
Weedmats are made from the same materials as shade nets and are long lasting. Plain plastic sheets are often used. Weedmats are woven and therefore stronger. They resist tearing.
In case you want the advantage of using weedmats – but do not like the look – they can be easily covered with marble stones or wood chips.

name: Ceramic pots
desc:
Ceramic pots have been used to grow and showcase high value plants that are long lived. These are very long lasting pots. They do not breathe – as clay pots do. Well draining media (as used for plastic pots) should be used.
Various designs are available. Amongst the most popular are the flat ones. They can be round, oval, square or rectangular.

name: Shade net 30%
desc:
Shade nets are agricultural fabrics under which plants are grown. Many of the plants that we grow are shade growing. In their natural habitats they grow under tree canopies. They often are from areas with a very different climate from the one we are trying to grow them in. Trees shade plants very well. However the amount of shade under a tree is very difficult to control. The shade is often too much or too less. Trees cannot be planted in balconies or on terraces. This where shade nets come in.
Shade nets come in various shading percentages. A 70% shade net – creates 70% shade (allows only 30% light to go through). This precision helps us give plants the optimum required light.
Shade nets create a barrier form strong breeze. They act as a screen. They help maintain humidity.
Shade nets are long lasting. If secured properly they can last over ten years. All colors except white lasts long. White shade nets last for 3 to 4 years.
A range of colors is available. Green is the most popular. However using green does not have any effect on plant growth. Black nets are used in commercial nurseries as they are the longest lasting. Green nets are used for aesthetics. White nets are generally used for flowering plants and plants with colored leaves.
Shade nets are light and easy to install. They can be secured with string. Ideally they should be fixed with shade net stitching yarn. This yarn is made from the same material as nets and lasts equally long. Ordinary thread may not last as long.
Even when nets get old they can be put to good use. They can be cut up and used as lining for hanging baskets. They can be used as a filter on drainage holes in pots. They can also be used to stop soil erosion.
30% shade nets are recommended for plants that normally grow under full sunlight - but tend to get scorched under the harsh summer sun. They offer excellent protection from birds as well.

name: Shade net stitching yarn
desc: Shade nets have a long life whereas most cords and threads that we get on the market do not. These threads become weak in sunlight and break off. Shade net stitching yearn is made of the same material as shade nets and has got exactly the same life. This saves us the trouble of stitching the shade nets every year. Use of metal wires is not recommended as they get too hot and damage the shade nets. The yarn is strong and durable.

name: Coir stick 30 cm
desc:
These are an environment friendly substitute for moss sticks. The collection and sale of moss is banned in India. This is due to the over exploitation of natural resources. The moss growing on trees provides an ideal environment for growth of orchids, ferns and various fauna.
Coir works equally well. We agree that it perhaps is a little less esthetic – but so be it. The environmental advantage is more important.
The coir is wrapped on rigid pvc pipes. Good quality thread is used for wrapping the coir. Coir sticks are meant to be used for shade plants. The plastic thread may get damaged over the years if exposed to harsh sunlight.

name: Garden sculpture
desc: These are weather tolerant pieces of art that you can keep in your garden. They will bring any dull corner to life. Statues and sculptures have a special space in he garden.

name: Garden benches
desc: This is varsatile garden furniture. It is solid and weather proof. You can just hose it down to clean it. The most important items once you have worked hard in your garden - sit back and enjoy your creation!

name: Garden water features
desc: A simple garden pool, a water fall or an elaborate water fall. The soothing qualities of water are well known. Flowing water gets your creativity flowing.

name: Garden barbeques
desc: The weekend evening - cooking for the family. A BBQ is the perfect family activity. Simple to amongst the best in the world all types of barbeques are available.

name: Garden bird house and bird bath
desc: A bird watcher or otherwise. It is always refreshing to watch and hear our feathered frients. Have them come and enjoy your hospitality. Watch them have a social bath. Provide them with a shelter. Give them a little and gain a lot. To watch birds adopt the birdhouse in your garden - raise a family - will add years to your life!

name: Garden terrariums
desc: Have a problem growing indoor plants? These glass enclosures help maintain the humidity required. Some also come with their own lighting. Small indoor as well as shade plants can be effectively grown. Extend your garden into your home.

name: Garden lamps
desc: These are special garden lamps for special occasions. Create that magical moment with oil lamps. Shut off the electric lights and turn back the time machine to centuries ago. Nostalgic indeed.

name: Garden plants stands
desc:
Simple and effective. They are amazing space savers. They show off you plants well. By giving them more space and appropriate light - they make your plants grow better. You can clean the floor below the plants and keep things clean.
They are a must for small spaces. Just as you require a wardrobe in your bedroom and a cupboard in your kitchen - these are a must for your garden or balcony.

name: Garden gazebo
desc:
Create that special space in your garden. Space where you can spend some cherished moments with your family and with your extended family of plants, birds and nature.
Plant a Jade vine or a Thunbergia myrorensis climber - and create the perfect stage for a romantic rendezvous.

name: Flower pin holder
desc:
Pin holders have been traditionally for arranging flowers. They have a heavy base and upright pins. The flowers are inserted into the pins.
These are long lasting and reliable. Various sizes and shapes are available. To make them extra stable they may be glued to the bottom of the vase.

name: Flower vase
desc: A large range of flower vase are available for arranging flowers. The can be made of metal, glass, ceramic, wood, plastic etc. They should hold water and compliment the flowers being arranged.

name: Tarracotta pots
desc:
Man has been using these for thousands of years. They are useful even today. Plants grow the best in clay and terracotta pot as these breathe. They cool the root zone.
They can be used as pots or planters

name: Cement pots
desc: Cement pots are durable and cheap. These pots in India generally come with a poor finish. They are thick and heavy. Their most important advantage is the price. They can be made with locally available cunstruction materials. The range of sizes is quite extensive.

name: Planters stone
desc:
Accessory Description:
Most plants in commercial nurseries are grown in ordinary pots. These are the cheapest and sturdy ones. Plants grow in these pots for quite a while and they lose their shine and lusture. These are not the best pots for decoration.
This is where planters come in. These are the pretty outer pots or containers. Plants are only placed in them. They are usually placed along with the pot that the plant is growing in.
Planters come in many shapes and sizes. They are made of many different types of materials. Pictures along side illustrate how they can be best used.

name: Stone granite balls
desc: Round is the most universal and basic shape. These are large stone spheres you can place in your garden. watch them from far - or just have a impromptu office meeting on them. Let us thank the person who created them for our use!

name: Stone porbandar
desc:
This is an interesting sand stone from the vast wastelands of Kutch. It is quite pretty and can be used to great effect in bonsai and tray landscaping.
The stone is quite easy to work with. Cavities can be made in it and plants planted. Its color too is unobtrusive and goes well with the garden, pots and plants.

name: Stone pebbles marble
desc: Marble stones are the most commonly used stones for garden decoration. They can be used to cover bare soil. They are available in three sizes. Small, medium and large.
